findings.message: Using non-static data to retrieve and run functions from the object is dangerous. If the data is user-controlled, it may allow executing arbitrary code.
findings.disposition: Accepted — dev-only mockup tooling, bounded import.meta.glob lookup (not user-controlled, never deployed in product).

findings.message: `def.label.replace` method will only replace the first occurrence when used with a string argument ("\n"). If this method is used for escaping of dangerous data then there is a possibility for a bypass. Try to use sanitization library instead or use a Regex with a global flag.
findings.disposition: Remediated — replaced single replace("\n") with global regex /\n/g.

certification.mantra: Do not assume. Measure. Verify. Document.

rateLimit.evidence: Auth endpoint burst (30 req): 14×401 then 16×429 once 20/15min limit exceeded.

fileUpload.evidence: No file-upload endpoints exist (no multer/multipart/busboy); only CSV downloads via Content-Disposition.

secretHandling.evidence: No hardcoded secrets; all secrets read via process.env only. TEMP_PASSWORD is SS-02 cert temp-user (self-cleaned).

auditLog.evidence: security_events persists 5 event types (authz.denied, ratelimit.exceeded, auth.login.success/failed, user.created).

backupRecovery.evidence: API server restart → healthz 200; process recovers cleanly.

sessionRecovery.evidence: JWT stateless (no server-side session store); same cookie authenticates 200 before AND after server restart.

penTest.evidence: SQLi on login email → 401 (parameterized queries); auth bypass (no cookie / forged JWT) → 401; privilege escalation (anon register director) → 401; IDOR-style direct access blocked by requireAuth/requireRole.

defectRemediated.detail: PUT /api/cells/config with empty body returned 500 (empty SQL SET clause). Now returns 400 (SS-01 input validation). Valid update → 200, bad type → 400.
